content.thinking: My test bug: with idle_ms=1000000000 and t=1000000000000, the idle check fires at the beginning of the event (t >= 0 + 1e9) → idle at 1e9, and the packet is dropped CONNECTION_CLOSED. The implementation is correct! Let me fix the test: use idle_ms=0 for that case, and test max idle separately.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open("test_bounds.py").read()
src = src.replace('''ok &= check("max t and pn", CFG(idle_ms=1000000000), [
        dg(1000000000000,1200,[pkt("I",MAXN,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",1000000000000)], conn_open(1000000000000), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))''',
'''ok &= check("max t and pn", CFG(), [
        dg(1000000000000,1200,[pkt("I",MAXN,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",1000000000000)], conn_open(1000000000000), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# max idle: fires at the deadline when t reaches it
ok &= check("max idle", CFG(idle_ms=1000000000), [
        dg(1000000000,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1000000000)],
        conn_idle(1000000000, src(0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))''')
open("test_bounds.py","w").write(src)
EOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_bounds.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAIL|ALL PASS|SOME FAILED" -A2
